source_kind: Author-written demonstration project brief, not an official regulation or a held-out test. Not sent to hosted providers.
scope: Only two author-selected bedrooms BEDROOM 1 and BEDROOM 2 and the selected D06 type on A-7. Completeness never extends to all rooms, stairs or exits of the building.

requirements.text: Every reviewed bedroom shall have a floor area of at least 9 m2.
requirements.subject: bedroom

requirements.text: Every reviewed bedroom shall have a confirmed path to HALL without passing through a bathroom.
requirements.subject: bedroom

requirements.text: If a reviewed bedroom has an area under 12 m2, it shall have a minimum internal width of 2.5 m.
requirements.subject: bedroom

requirements.text: The reviewed D06 door type shall provide a net clear opening of at least 0.8 m.
requirements.subject: door

requirements.text: The reviewed unit shall have at least one confirmed final exit at ground level.
requirements.subject: unit

limits: Rule meanings and rectangle/path interpretations authored by benchmark author with no independent review.
No synthetic clear-width or exit values are supplied. D06 nominal dimensions do not establish net clear opening.
The final exit inventory cannot be confirmed from a second-floor sheet.
This measures assisted execution after author evidence, not automated source interpretation or perception accuracy.
